core_obligations: The extension morphism U' to U equals Spec(k') to Spec(k), hence is affine, surjective and flat. Openness: by morphisms-lemma-scheme-over-field-universally-open the morphisms s, t : R to U and U' to U are universally open. Surjectivity and flatness of s and t: R is not empty and U is the spectrum of a field, so s and t are surjective and flat. Assembly: every arrow of the defining diagram is built from s, t, U' to U by base change and composition, so morphisms-lemma-base-change-surjective and morphisms-lemma-composition-surjective give surjectivity, morphisms-lemma-composition-open gives universal openness, morphisms-lemma-base-change-affine and morphisms-lemma-composition-affine give affineness, and morphisms-lemma-base-change-flat and morphisms-lemma-composition-flat give flatness. In particular the dotted arrow R' to R is a base change of the affine morphism U' to U, hence affine. Conclusion: all morphisms of the defining diagram are surjective, flat and universally open, and the dotted arrow R' to R is in addition affine.
proof_roadmap: Observe U' to U is Spec(k') to Spec(k), hence affine, surjective and flat, and get universal openness of s, t and U' to U from morphisms-lemma-scheme-over-field-universally-open (proof lines 1242-1245).
Get surjectivity and flatness of s, t from R not empty and U the spectrum of a field (proof lines 1246-1247).

Assemble the properties of every diagram arrow via the base change and composition lemmas for surjective, open, affine and flat morphisms, noting the dotted arrow is a base change of an affine morphism (proof lines 1247-1255).
